forum.content_text:
Since ~2 hours I get thousands of mails from [notification@communitymailer.st.com](mailto:notification@communitymailer.st.com) mainly with STM8 stuff from the last years.

What's going wrong here? Is it only me? I never was interested in STM8, just STM32...

(I unsubscribed from "others: hardware and software" to survive the day.)

P.S.: they all have the same init line like this:

```

Hi mfgkw,

Lina_DABASINSKAITE (Community manager) moved a topic in Others: hardware and software on 2020-09-08 8:15 AM:

Where can I get the stm8s discovery dev.zip file? I would like to download the application code that is advertised with the eval/demo board but can't find it anywhere on ST.com. Thanks.

```

They all seem to start with "Lina\_DABASINSKAITE (Community manager) moved a topic in Others: hardware and software on " ...
